newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SGIO says still keen on expansion.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SGIO says still keen on expansion.

text.p: Insurer SGIO Insurance Ltd said it was still keen to expand within Australia and overseas.

"It is our intention to evaluate growth opportunities through further expansion across Australia and eventually overseas, where we envisage the provision of products and services to new customers, either directly or through strategic alliances, will increase profits," managing director Ian Brown said in SGIO's annual report.
In April, SGIO chairman Ron Cohen said the group was interested in expanding domestically and abroad.
Last month, SGIO reported a net profit of A$29.35 million in the year to June 30 compared with A$13.52 million a year eralier. SGIO shares closed one cent lower at A$1.44.
